name: Sterling-Nakamura Legal Evidence Preservation Kit LEPK-2
product_name: Sterling-Nakamura Legal Evidence Preservation Kit LEPK-2
description: A forensic evidence collection and preservation kit designed to maintain an unbroken chain of custody from crime scene to courtroom. The LEPK-2 includes tamper-evident collection bags with embedded blockchain verification chips, a portable evidence scanner that photographs and catalogs items with cryptographic timestamps, sterile collection tools, and a sealed transport case with environmental monitoring. Every action taken with the kit is logged to Sterling-Nakamura's Blockchain Governance Protocol, creating an immutable record that cannot be challenged in court.
legality: Licensed — law enforcement and legal professionals

specifications.verification: Any BGP node can verify evidence integrity

story_hooks: An LEPK-2's blockchain log revealed that evidence was accessed outside the documented chain of custody — someone with physical access tampered with the evidence and the kit recorded it.
A defense attorney has challenged the LEPK-2 system itself, arguing that blockchain-verified evidence creates an illusion of infallibility that prejudices juries against legitimate challenges.

physical_description.visual_profile: A professional-grade forensic kit housed in a modular hard case system. The primary transport case is a sleek aluminum briefcase with integrated smart-lock panel. Internal organization features a custom foam insert with precisely cut compartments. The scanner unit is a compact handheld device with a 3-inch display screen. Collection bags are semi-transparent polymer with holographic security threads visible under UV light.
physical_description.dimensions: Transport case: 55cm × 35cm × 12cm. Scanner unit: palm-sized, approximately 12cm × 8cm × 4cm.
physical_description.weight_description: 4 kg total kit — briefcase-sized, requires two-handed carrying or shoulder strap for extended transport
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed aircraft-grade aluminum case exterior; anti-static polymer internal trays; sterile polypropylene for collection tools and bags
physical_description.finish: Matte anodized aluminum with textured grip panels; semi-gloss holographic overlay on evidence bags; scanner has soft-touch matte black finish with chrome accent trim
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: gunmetal gray and matte black. Accents: electric blue LED indicators and holographic security threads (cyan-to-purple shift). Sterling-Nakamura branding in chrome silver.
physical_description.interface_elements: Scanner display: 3-inch high-contrast screen with touch-sensitive edge controls. Case smart-lock: biometric pad with status LED ring. Evidence bags: QR-code labels with embedded blockchain chip visible as small metallic squares. Interior: labeled compartments for tweezers, swabs, scrapers, measurement rulers, protective gloves, and chemical analysis strips.
distinctive_features: Holographic security threads embedded in evidence bags that shift color when tampered
Blockchain chip verification indicators — small metallic nodules visible on bag seals
Scanner unit with integrated UV verification light for authenticity checks
Environmental monitoring display on case interior showing temperature/humidity graph
Cryptographic timestamp LED that pulses when logging chain-of-custody data
Modular foam insert with tool silhouettes for inventory verification
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Sterling-Nakamura corporate logo (geometric interlocking S-N symbol) embossed on case lid in chrome. BGP (Blockchain Governance Protocol) certification seal. Serial number and blockchain registry QR-code on interior label. Tier-2 authorization stamp.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but showing active use — slight scuffs on case corners from field transport, adhesive residue from evidence tags on foam, scanner screen with protective film still applied, blue LED indicators glowing softly when powered
